limitations: Post-holdout development: the October confirmation interval was evaluated by an earlier model. It is not a fresh blind test.
Ten variants per resource were selected solely by September development MAE. Confirmation was inspected after selection receipts were saved.
Additional rolling folds are post-selection diagnostics and cannot erase historical dataset reuse or certify absence of overfitting.
Pool, zone and horizon errors are correlated. Block bootstrap intervals are descriptive, conditional on this short single-region history.
Seven CPU pools worsen; B200 cold-start fallback is retained. No unseen-region or unseen-hardware generalization claim.
Prediction-error improvements are not scheduling savings. No production API/default or risk/uncertainty model changed.
